QuestInfo.name: Finding Fanzy
QuestInfo.0: You brought the Firewood, and guess what? Grendel the Really Old is still a no-show. At least #bThree Moon#k has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: The food is ready, but Three Moon wants you to wait. He asked you to find #bFanzy#k at the #bGiant Tree#k. There better be eggs left when you get back.
QuestInfo.2: Fanzy gave you a gift, something that might help you fit in better in Maple World. More importantly, he said that #bGrendel the Really Old#k might have arrived.
